{{Quote|I have painstakingly built a vast network of spies and operatives embedded throughout the Sith, Republic and Jedi alike. I have fingers, eyes and ears everywhere.|Darth Baras|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
[[Darth Baras]]' '''spy network''' was an organization of several [[Spy/Legends|agents]] infiltrated within both the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] affiliated with furthering [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Baras' goals.

{{Company-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Don't strike. I'm a secret Imperial agent working directly for Darth Baras.''"<br />"''That's not news to me. You discover and keep information for Baras that he uses to gain power and control others.''"<br />"''My work keeps rogue Imperial elements from destablilizing the Empire. But that's just part of what I do.<br />I'm essential in the fight for Corellia. I steer Republic-aligned forces into battles they can't win. Shut me down and we lose the war.|[[Senks]], an agent of Baras, bargains for his life with the [[Empire's Wrath|Emperor's Wrath]]|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic" />}}
Darth Baras' spy network first appeared in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.
